message: Every review the engine has installed (the plan-review and pre-submission personas under .claude/agents/) must be run by a build stage — otherwise it ships looking like an active review while never actually checking your changes. The Build protocol records which stage runs which review roster (review_consumers in .engine/build-protocol.json; the rosters themselves are deliverable_review there and the Project Manager's plan-review roster); this check reads that record through the shared loader, compares it against the reviews actually installed, and goes red when an installed review is run by no stage. To fix a red: either wire the flagged review into a stage by adding its lens to the roster that stage consumes, or remove the persona from .claude/agents/. This check reads only whether a stage is recorded as consuming each installed lens; it does not verify the stage genuinely spawns that review at build time (your pull-request review and the build itself cover that), and a review whose lens is consumed but that ships zero personas is a disclosed no-op, not a finding. If the protocol is missing, off schema, or names no lens, the check fails closed rather than passing an unjudged roster.
